comparison.objective: Press a flanged bearing onto a robot-link shaft until seated past a spring ball.
comparison.physical_skill: Bore-to-shaft alignment, axial sliding, sustained pressing, and detent traversal.
comparison.success_condition: Bearing clicks past the spring ball and seats on the shaft shoulder; detailed alignment and damage tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Both require coaxial alignment and force regulation, but bearing insertion tests sustained axial press-fit seating, whereas the candidate tests a separately delivered impact that fractures a notch plus recovery of released tangs.
